title: Add documented PSL attribute signature help
body:
Adds documented signature help for PSL attribute arguments using shared built-in and extension metadata.

## Changes
- Require documentation on attribute specs, nested signatures and parameter declarations; migrate repository-owned declarations and completion consumers.
- Register automatic `(` and `,` triggers and explicit requests, with named-parameter selection, nested-call help, unknown-function suppression and incomplete-input recovery.
- Add declaration/type, provider, protocol and exact-comma regression coverage while preserving completion behavior.

## Why
Declaration-owned metadata provides authoritative editor help without a separate built-in catalogue or executing argument parsers.

## Scope
Attribute authoring metadata, affected consumers, signature help, tests and documentation. This intentionally requires extension authors to document declarations and wrap named parameter types in documented descriptors. No PSL syntax, runtime validation, emitted-contract, hover or custom editor UI changes. Upstream synchronization was conflict-free with no manual resolution.

## Verification
At merged HEAD `547100129d3366cddffd94340f52997ff96cf949`: frozen install, prerequisite builds and dependency-ordered build/test/typecheck/lint for all nine affected packages passed: 5,301 tests passed, plus 3 expected failures and 1 skipped PostgreSQL adapter test. Dependency lint and fixture check passed, including 204/204 integration fixture emissions with no generated tracked diff.

Independent schema-user and extension-author browser journeys passed at feature HEAD `97f3a9962ac6ec42af3196024815cc23ee032bf9`. Refreshed merged-build browser acceptance is not claimed; publication without waiting for it was explicitly authorized. Full integration/e2e suites were not rerun.

Two persistent LSP findings contradict fresh passing compiler checks and current declaration exports; dispositioned as a tool-state discrepancy, not a source-repair blocker. Diagnostics are not claimed clean.

<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **New Features**
  * Added signature help for PSL attributes and function calls, including parameter documentation, named aliases, and nested arguments.
  * Added richer completion snippets with optional argument placeholders and automatic parameter-hint triggering.
  * The language-server playground now supports Tab-based parameter hints within snippets.
  * Attribute specifications across SQL, MongoDB, and PostgreSQL now expose descriptive documentation.

* **Documentation**
  * Updated architecture guidance for `allowEmpty` list options and documented PostgreSQL row-level security attributes.
